summary: ansible_connection selects the protocol: network_cli (CLI over SSH), netconf (XML over SSH), httpapi (HTTP/S API), all persistent and needing network_os; local is deprecated. httpapi replaces eos_eapi and nxos_nxapi.
questions: Which ansible_connection should I use for network devices?
Is connection: local still supported for network modules?

answer_card.title: Network connection types
answer_card.answer_md:
| `ansible_connection` | Protocol | Requires | Persistent |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ansible.netcommon.network_cli` | CLI over SSH | network_os | yes |
| `ansible.netcommon.netconf` | XML over SSH | network_os | yes |
| `ansible.netcommon.httpapi` | API over HTTP(S) | network_os | yes |
| `local` | depends on provider | provider | no |

`local` is **deprecated**; use a persistent type so hosts and credentials are defined once, not per task. `httpapi` replaces `eos_eapi` and `nxos_nxapi`. CLI over SSH is most common.
